dedupe_keys.name: rapid multifaceted data collection on the aftermath of the francis scott key bridge collapse in the dc maryland virginia area

description: RAPID: Multifaceted Data Collection on the Aftermath of the Francis Scott Key Bridge Collapse in the DC-Maryland-Virginia Area is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Xianfeng Yang, University of Maryland College Park (umd.edu). After the Key Bridge collapse in Baltimore, this project aims to gather data, particularly perishable information, to help the research community analyze the transportation and economic impacts resulting from this incident. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: bridge collapse, transportation impacts, disaster preparedness. Published 2026-07-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
